# Rebecca 1.1.0

Rebecca 1.1.0 adds precise, delegated subscription placeholder management. Operators can now keep inactive subscriptions safe without forcing every service and reseller to share the same message.

## Highlights

- 🧩 **Per-admin, per-service placeholders** — configure an independent placeholder policy for every admin and service assignment.
- 📝 **Separate status messages** — expired, traffic-limited, and manually disabled subscriptions can each return a different message.
- 🔐 **Delegated management** — full-access and authorized sudo admins can manage all assignments, while standard admins can manage only their own services when the new permission is granted.
- 🎨 **Focused settings UI** — a new responsive Placeholder page provides clear service selection, status-specific fields, supported variables, and localized English and Persian copy.
- 🛡️ **Safe inactive outputs** — placeholder behavior applies consistently across raw, JSON, Clash, sing-box, Outline, OpenVPN, WireGuard, HTML, and subscription-info responses without exposing live connection details.
- 🔄 **Backward compatibility** — installations using the previous global placeholder option continue to work until a scoped policy is saved.

## Reliability fixes

- Isolated node usage RPC deadlines so one slow node cannot distort the rest of a collection cycle.
- Expired stale WireGuard session leases and improved stopped-node container cleanup.
- Excluded deleted users from admin totals and made expiry shortcuts cumulative.
- Moved Telegram reports off request paths and refreshed wildcard host values safely.

## Upgrade notes

No manual database migration is required. Existing admin subscription settings are preserved, and scoped policies are stored alongside them. Grant **Manage own subscription placeholders** to each standard admin that should have access.
